name: Do I need cement backer board or regular drywall behind a kitchen tile backsplash?

mainEntity.name: Do I need cement backer board or regular drywall behind a kitchen tile backsplash?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Do I need special drywall or backer board behind a tile backsplash?
Standard or moisture-resistant drywall is suitable for a decorative kitchen backsplash where light water splashes occur, provided you use the proper adhesive. However, if the backsplash directly abuts a high-moisture sink basin or extends down to a wash station, installing cement backer board offers greater durability and resistance to water degradation. The tradeoff is that cement board is heavier and more difficult to cut around numerous electrical receptacles, so homeowners frequently choose purple drywall for dry-to-moderate splash zones and cement board strictly for wet utility areas.
acceptedAnswer.description: Moisture-resistant drywall works well for standard decorative backsplashes, while cement backer board is preferred in high-splash or deep-sink utility areas.
